predecessors.name: Mayapan
predecessors.text: Sotuta, the Cocom province, 'landlocked, north of Maní'; the pages give no extent

successors.name: Spanish Empire
successors.text: Sotuta, the Cocom province, 'landlocked, north of Maní'; the pages give no extent

ledger.x: 1441: 'all of the Cocom family, except one who was away in Honduras conducting trade, were killed' at Mayapan; the Cocom are later the lords of Sotuta, 'implacable enemies of the European colonisers' (conquest page).

1545: 'Nachi Cocom, colonial governor of Sotuta' (Kuchkabal page), so the province is under Spanish rule by 1545; the conquest page has the Sotuta Cocom resisting until then (they joined the 1542 assault on Mérida).

wars.name: Allied assault on Mérida
wars.outcome: The Kuchkabal page has an alliance of Cupul, Cochuah and Sotuta in 'their allied assault on Spanish forces at Mérida in 1542'; the outcome is not stated.
